unparsed_ddl.what: anonymous DECLARE/BEGIN block: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'ALTER TABLE fixture_meta ADD (marker, value)' guarded by a user_tab_columns count
unparsed_ddl.disposition: parser blind spot (F16) but harmless here: the only object it touches is FIXTURE_META (out of scope)
MERGE is not a parsed statement (F16); seed_rows cannot count MERGE-fed rows; FIXTURE_META only

other_observations: ALL_TABLES.num_rows is NULL for all 20 tables (never analyzed; LAST_ANALYZED NULL) so census row_estimate is null everywhere; DBMS_STATS not run (legacy read-only). Recon baseline is .migration/fixture_counts.json, not the census.

Live triggers: events kept as one string ('UPDATE OR DELETE') and sequence_assigns always []; DDL splits events and reads bodies, so DDL classifies TRG_BILLING_AUDIT_LOG_ID / TRG_CUSTOMER_MASTER_SEQ / TRG_ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE_SEQ as sequence_trigger_identity while live flags all 7 as trigger_business_logic (F15). census_diff compares (name, table) only, so this is invisible to the diff.
DDL finding reference_data_candidate on ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE is wrong (F17): EAV is the entity-attribute table (66 rows in the mmprt seed + 4 static), also tagged as the eav trap by both censuses.
Both scheduler jobs are DISABLED live (USER_SCHEDULER_JOBS enabled=FALSE) — the DDL census records repeat_interval but not enabled; 04_jobs.sql creates them enabled => FALSE.

DDL seed_rows (03_seed_static.sql) match fixture_counts.static_rows_outside_namespace for TENANTS (11 incl. OtterWorks Admin -> 10 named + admin), CUSTOMER_MASTER 2 vs 1 live static (the second seed row is in the mmprt namespace count) — not a census defect, recon baseline stays fixture_counts.json.
